So here is my plan. Currently the `to_ir` which is the entrypoint for the conversion. My plan is to move the logic inside it and related functions to a sperate `export` module. I want to keep the implementation of the conversion same as it is now, I can plan any changes required in that in a later issue.

For the `export` module, in my opnion `qasm` can be one of the exported representations, in future we may have more.

In the `to_ir`, I will use the `QasmExporter` for now, but ideally I would want there to be no `to_ir`(or `from_ir`) function and exports only to be handled by explicitly calling the exporter from the clients code.

Let me know what you think about this.
Thanks for this. I am starting on this, and will share updates, progress and any questions on this thread (till I raise a draft PR)

One complication I can see is that today the OpenQASM serialization logic is spread in several places - each object knows how to serialize itself. For example:
- Circuit._to_openqasm: https://github.com/amazon-braket/amazon-braket-sdk-python/blob/a8666a1c709e56ae0594e8d19a503edaa57d5ca4/src/braket/circuits/circuit.py#L1400
- Gate._to_openqasm: https://github.com/amazon-braket/amazon-braket-sdk-python/blob/a8666a1c709e56ae0594e8d19a503edaa57d5ca4/src/braket/circuits/gate.py#L141
- H(Observable)._to_openqasm: https://github.com/amazon-braket/amazon-braket-sdk-python/blob/a8666a1c709e56ae0594e8d19a503edaa57d5ca4/src/braket/circuits/observables.py#L61
- and quite a few others

Would the idea be to move all of this code into an export module, which knows how to serialize each of these different types of objects? My worry is that now we would have to move a bunch of internal details about each object into a centralized place, which kind of breaks the abstraction model that's currently in place where each object knows how to serialize itself.

Or perhaps you're thinking of something simpler?

Thanks, that makes sense — I agree that fully centralizing all serialization logic right away could break the current abstraction where each object is responsible for serializing itself.

For an initial step, I was thinking of keeping the current _to_openqasm methods on the objects, and instead moving any shared logic (formatting, helpers, common utilities) into a dedicated module.

The idea would be to make this a gradual refactor rather than a single large change.

Longer term, I do think it could be worth exploring a more explicit exporter layer, where the entry point for different IRs is unified and easier to extend. But that could build on top of the current design rather than replacing it immediately.

From looking at other SDKs like Qiskit and PennyLane, a more centralized export approach seems to scale better as additional IR formats are introduced.

This feels especially relevant for a platform like Amazon Braket, which is designed to support multiple compute providers, each potentially requiring their own pluggable export modules alongside Amazon’s IRs.

I think we can move toward that gradually, starting with small refactors.
